newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Jan 6.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch company results for week beginning Monday, Jan 6 include:
Profit figures are net profits before extraordinary items and in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
Securities houses surveyed included: Amstgeld, Bangert Pontier, Delta Lloyd Bank, Generale Bank, Gilissen, Kempen & Co, Labouchere, Lanschot Bankiers, Rabo/IRIS, NIB Strating, Suez and Wesselius.
NOTE - Banks and brokers interested in contributing to Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
For the week starting January 13 we are collecting year result forecasts for Randstad and Ahrend and half year 1996/97 result forecast for OPG.
